folds: anchored 60d/20d, full 24h purge, training effective n>=30, train-only choice
bootstrap: UTC 4h cluster means, circular moving block ceil(sqrt(n)), 2000 draws seed 0x51a7, n<30 insufficient
random_control: 20 deterministic uniform closed 15m starts in same UTC date and 4h session, same symbol/direction; full horizon required
human_entry: zone midpoint, ladder split equal initial risk; raw explicit market overrides bridge; notified completed trades next-open copy proxy
human_stop: only supplied valid stop; missing stop never imputed for R
human_tp: supplied size_pct normalized if sum approximately 1; otherwise equal risk fractions; break-even next bar only if raw explicitly says so
execution: common 15m for human/mechanical; 1m sensitivity when continuous; strict tick crossing, stop first, no limit fill-bar TP; marketable limits rejected with 0R retained
dedup: same trader symbol side plan within 24h; exact source always once; retrospective prefix excluded
promotion: research only; no production gate/active/strategy writes; retrospective hypotheses not prospective OOS
